title: Icon Costume 솔로 #021 · hourglass bombshell · 글래디에이터 · lambskin nappa · 손 허리 · 옥상 테라스 · 데코라
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 20s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, long wavy balayage hair — wearing a skin-tight micro gladiator set, a cropped sleeveless cuirass-style top of ultra-thin matte bronze lambskin nappa with sculpted ridges and two gold shoulder buckles, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to the cropped hem and the two sides of the lambskin nappa fully covering her bust, ending right under her bust with her whole midriff and stomach bare, and a micro skirt of layered leather strips of the same lambskin nappa hanging around her hips in a ring of short tabs with gold studs, the ring sitting at the top of her hip bones with a plain ultra-high gap between the tabs up the right side from the hem to her hip bone, the hem ending just below her hip bones, and a gold arm band on her left upper arm, her arms and legs bare, the lambskin nappa shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin, fully opaque, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small beauty mark beside her navel and faint freckles on her chest V and the backs of her hands. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin lambskin nappa molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the sculpted ridges, the gold shoulder buckles and the ring of studded leather strips swinging at her hips, fine stretch lines and a soft sheen. Pose: full frontal wide stance, both fists pressing outer hips outward to absolute maximum — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, platform stiletto ballet boots made of glossy bronze leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in bronze lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, and thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: bright pastel pink and yellow eyeshadow, thick lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, small star and heart shapes painted on the cheeks only, glossy candy-pink lips.

Background: a bright modern rooftop terrace with a pale deck floor, a waist-high glass railing, a standard door and a city skyline in the daylight haze, in warm golden late-afternoon light, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
